features.text: Protective square toe design acts as a bumper to shield sensitive areas and accommodate post-surgical dressings
Semi-rigid sole provides stable support while helping distribute weight evenly during recovery
Adjustable straps allow for customized fit as swelling changes throughout your healing process
PDAC approved with L3260 coding, meeting Medicare requirements for post-operative footwear

measurement: To ensure optimal healing support, finding the right fit is crucial. Consult our sizing chart or connect with our medical team through our Perfect Fit Promise at for personalized fitting assistance.
